summary: Full backend and frontend testing of One Dollar Dream app. All 9 backend API tests pass. All critical frontend flows work correctly including pledge form submission, success state with referral link, referral code tracking via ?ref= URL param, admin panel with search, contact form, and all 7 inner pages loading.

issues: Contact form inputs use data-testid but no name attributes — minor but contact form submission works correctly via data-testid selectors

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — should use lifespan context manager in FastAPI 0.93+, but functionally fine
Admin routes /api/admin/pledges and /api/admin/contacts have no authentication — anyone can access pledge data including emails. Consider adding basic auth or secret token for production
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test pledges and 1 contact message during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Backend 9/9 pass. Frontend: homepage, pledge form, success state, referral tracking, admin panel, contact form, all inner pages (/how-it-works, /grants, /phases, /transparency, /team, /contact, /submit-pitch) all load correctly. Admin panel at /admin is unauthenticated — potential security concern for production.
